strings.en: Jessie: Hey! You, Champion!{NEWLINE}What are you trying to pull?!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『啊……我……嗯……{NEWLINE}火箭队,知道我的厉害就赶紧离开,{CLEAR}不许再欺负别人了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ah... I... um... Team{NEWLINE}Rocket, now that you know{CLEAR}how strong I am, clear out!{CLEAR}And no more picking on people!

strings.zh: 武藏『真是个无聊的小鬼！
strings.en: Jessie: What a lame brat!

strings.zh: 小次郎『我感觉受到了深深的欺骗。
strings.en: James: I feel deeply betrayed.

strings.zh: 喵喵『这种人也能当冠军啊喵。
strings.en: Meowth: And this is what{NEWLINE}passes for a Champion, meow?

strings.zh: 武藏、小次郎、喵喵『走啦走啦！
strings.en: Jessie, James & Meowth:{NEWLINE}Let’s go, let’s go!

strings.zh: 武藏『哈哈,我就说嘛。{NEWLINE}区区冠军怎么会是我们的对手！
strings.en: Jessie: Ha ha, what did I tell you?{NEWLINE}A mere Champion is no match for us!

strings.zh: 你真的是联盟冠军吗？{NEWLINE}怎么看起来这么弱？
strings.en: Are you really the League{NEWLINE}Champion? Why do you seem so weak?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『啊……我……{NEWLINE}我的王牌精灵今天没有带在身上。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ah... I... My ace{NEWLINE}Pokémon isn’t with me today.

strings.zh: 武藏『闪开啦！别妨碍我办事。
strings.en: Jessie: Out of the way!{NEWLINE}Don’t get in my way.

strings.zh: 你不要过来啊！
strings.en: Stay away from me!

strings.zh: 肥蓝猫『Puuuu——ru！
strings.en: Purugly: Puuuu-ru!

strings.zh: 武藏『嗯？这只肥蓝猫是想保护主人吗？
strings.en: Jessie: Hm? This Purugly{NEWLINE}wants to protect its owner?

strings.zh: 小次郎『真是不自量力,{NEWLINE}联盟冠军都不是我们的对手。{CLEAR}就凭你也想阻挡我们？
strings.en: James: How foolish. Not even{NEWLINE}the League Champion could beat{CLEAR}us. You think you can stop us?

strings.zh: 武藏『哦、唔、啊！
strings.en: Jessie: Oh! Ugh! Aah!

strings.zh: 小次郎『好疼好疼！
strings.en: James: Ow, ow, ow!

strings.zh: 武藏『喵喵,你不也是猫吗？{NEWLINE}快去挠它！
strings.en: Jessie: Meowth, aren’t you{NEWLINE}a cat too? Go scratch it!

strings.zh: 喵喵『你看体型也知道{NEWLINE}我们不是一个重量级的喵。
strings.en: Meowth: Just look at our sizes. We{NEWLINE}ain’t in the same weight class, meow.

strings.zh: 武藏『可恶啊,居然跑出这么个精灵,{NEWLINE}比联盟冠军还难对付。
strings.en: Jessie: Dammit, where did this{NEWLINE}Pokémon come from? It’s harder to{CLEAR}deal with than the League Champion!

strings.zh: 小次郎『是因为对主人的忠心,{NEWLINE}才会这么强吗？
strings.en: James: Is it this strong because{NEWLINE}of its loyalty to its owner?

strings.zh: 喵喵『占卜的人说咱们今天运气不好,{NEWLINE}所以我看还是先撤退吧喵。
strings.en: Meowth: The fortune-teller said{NEWLINE}we’d have bad luck today, so I{CLEAR}say we retreat for now, meow.

strings.zh: 武藏『嗯,有道理。撤退！
strings.en: Jessie: Hmm, good point. Retreat!

strings.zh: 肥蓝猫！幸好有你保护我,{NEWLINE}火箭队真是太吓人了,呜呜呜……{SCROLL}我都不知道你原来这么强！{NEWLINE}虽然我一直想把你给放生,{CLEAR}但是你却没有抛弃我……{CLEAR}呜呜呜……看来是我错了。{CLEAR}我太在意你的外表,{CLEAR}却忽视了你对我的感情。{SCROLL}对不起啦肥蓝猫,{NEWLINE}我以后再也不会说放生的事了,{CLEAR}我希望你能永远陪在我身边。
strings.en: Purugly! Thank goodness you{NEWLINE}protected me. Team Rocket{CLEAR}was so scary... *sob*...{SCROLL}I had no idea you were this strong! I{NEWLINE}kept wanting to release you, but you{CLEAR}never abandoned me... *sob*... I was{CLEAR}wrong. I cared too much about your{CLEAR}looks and ignored your feelings for me.{SCROLL}I’m sorry, Purugly. I’ll never talk{NEWLINE}about releasing you again. I want{CLEAR}you to stay by my side forever.

strings.zh: 谢谢冠军大人出手相救！{NEWLINE}不然真不知道会发生什么可怕的事。{CLEAR}这是我的一点谢礼,请你收下吧。
strings.en: Thank you for saving me, Champion! Who{NEWLINE}knows what awful things would have{CLEAR}happened otherwise. Here’s a little{CLEAR}something to thank you. Please take it.

strings.zh: 谢谢冠军大人出手相救！{NEWLINE}不然真不知道会发生什么可怕的事。
strings.en: Thank you for saving me, Champion!{NEWLINE}Who knows what awful things{CLEAR}would have happened otherwise.

strings.zh: 我以后再也不会说放生的事了,{NEWLINE}我希望肥蓝猫能永远陪在我身边。
strings.en: I’ll never talk about releasing{NEWLINE}Purugly again. I want Purugly{CLEAR}to stay by my side forever.

strings.zh: 我曾经是一名口袋妖怪训练家,{NEWLINE}但我不喜欢用精灵战斗。{CLEAR}于是就开了这间借助精灵能力{CLEAR}为人类治疗病痛的诊所。
strings.en: I used to be a Pokémon Trainer,{NEWLINE}but I didn’t like making Pokémon{CLEAR}fight. So I opened this clinic,{CLEAR}where Pokémon use their abilities{CLEAR}to treat people’s ailments.

strings.zh: 咩利羊『Maaa——ree！
strings.en: Mareep: Maaa-ree!

strings.zh: 线球『Spiii——na！
strings.en: Spinarak: Spiii-na!

strings.zh: 这人只要上了年纪,{NEWLINE}就肯定会腰酸背痛。{CLEAR}幸好咩利羊能用静电疗法{CLEAR}帮我缓解肌肉疼痛。{SCROLL}我感觉自己一刻也离不开{NEWLINE}这只可爱的小羊了。
strings.en: Once you get older, your back is{NEWLINE}bound to ache. Luckily, Mareep{CLEAR}can ease my muscle pain with{CLEAR}static electricity therapy.{SCROLL}I feel like I can’t go a moment{NEWLINE}without this cute little sheep.

strings.zh: 用线球丝包扎伤口,结实又透气,{NEWLINE}而且还能加速愈合呢！
strings.en: Bandages made of Spinarak silk are{NEWLINE}strong and breathable, and they{CLEAR}even help wounds heal faster!
